description: An AR/VR Test Engineer ensures the quality and functionality of augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality(VR) applications and hardware. They design and execute tests, identify and track defects, and collaboratewith developers to improve the user experience. This role requires a strong understanding of softwaretesting methodologies, AR/VR technologies, and relevant development tools.
awardingBodyName: Nasscom  National Association of Software and Service Companies

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Define test strategy and test plan for the solution in collaboration with appropriate stakeholders
Run the simulated test cases, identify automation opportunities and evaluate the outcomes
Identify, document, and track defects and issues found during testing and communicating them to the development team for resolution
Provide support in maintaining and troubleshooting the AR/VR solution

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.REMARKS: The relevant experience would include work, internship, and apprenticeship after completing relevant educational qualifications.
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELEVANTSPECIALIZATION: Relevant Experience in job roles related to ARVR /Computer Science/IT
